main.description: A post in a thread (a forum reply or a chat message in a thread). Optional module: apps that already store posts natively may write only garden.msg.thread.

thread.description: The thread this post belongs to: the at:// URI of a garden.msg.thread record, or of the app's native thread record.

parent.description: The post this one answers. Absent means it answers the thread itself.

author.description: Who wrote the post, when the record is written on their behalf.

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the post, without markup.

content.description: The post in an app-native format. Open union.

updatedAt.description: When the post was last edited. Absent means never edited.
